stations.title: Dilys
stations.say: Can my friend skip to the classes?
stations.note: Her friend uses a screen reader.

stations.title: Screen reader
stations.text: Skips to the main part, if a page has one.

captions: Dilys's friend opens the studio's page with her screen reader and wants the classes.
Her reader could skip straight to the main part, but the page does not have one.
You mark the header, the main content, each section and the footer.
She skips the top of the page and lands right on the main content.
Same look as before. Now the page is complete, well-built HTML, ready for styles.
